value.rationale: The original stochastic hypergraph theory supplies only strict sufficient gain inequalities. An explicit sharp three-person variance margin and stabilization at the noise-neutral boundary are natural structural boundary questions. The nonconstant decreasing group response restores mean-square synchronization where constant noise retains the second moment, giving a mechanistic mathematical distinction with a sharp quantitative rate. Three agents are the smallest genuine hyperedge, so this is not an arbitrary narrow slice.
